name: noesis
title: Tryambakam Noesis
description: Ritual guidance in Raycast for pulse cadence, NadaBrahman remedies, Daily Witness, and guided practice flows.
author: mage_narayan

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: Tryambakam Noesis Access Key
preferences.description: Secure password preference for your Noesis access key. Preferred over legacy local storage.

preferences.name: baseUrl
preferences.title: Noesis Base URL
preferences.description: Optional fallback API URL when onboarding has not stored one yet.

preferences.name: witnessUrl
preferences.title: Daily Witness API URL
preferences.description: Trusted Witness gateway URL used only when the execution route preference is set to Witness.

preferences.name: executionRoute
preferences.title: Execution Route
preferences.description: Choose where engine and workflow runs execute: directly against Selemene or through the Witness gateway.

preferences.name: readingHistoryLimit
preferences.title: Reading History Cache
preferences.description: Maximum number of reading rows to keep in the local SQLite cache.

preferences.name: cacheRawPayloads
preferences.title: Store Raw Payloads
preferences.label: Keep full raw result JSON in the local cache
preferences.description: Keep full raw result JSON in the local cache for debugging. When off, Raycast stores only minimized payloads.

preferences.name: pulseMode
preferences.title: Pulse Fallback Mode
preferences.description: Choose which source pulse should drive the menu bar when the current NadaBrahman remedy is unavailable.

commands.name: dashboard
commands.title: Dashboard
commands.description: Ritual dashboard for current remedy, pulse inputs, guided actions, and the full engine and flow libraries

commands.name: engines
commands.title: Engines
commands.description: Browse the engine library that powers pulse inputs, remedies, and deeper readings

commands.name: workflows
commands.title: Workflows
commands.description: Browse guided ritual flows with workflow composition previews and cached reading context

commands.name: readings
commands.title: Readings
commands.description: Browse cached reading history with payload previews and detail views

commands.name: profile
commands.title: Profile
commands.description: Edit shared birth data, timezone, and reusable defaults that shape every ritual run

commands.name: api-key
commands.title: API Key
commands.description: Connect, edit, or rotate the Noesis access key and warm the local cache

commands.name: daily-witness
commands.title: Daily Witness
commands.description: One-tap Daily Witness ritual with profile defaults, guided inputs, and dyad-backed synthesis

commands.name: daily-practice
commands.title: Daily Practice
commands.description: Run the default daily-practice workflow as a one-tap ritual with reusable profile inputs

commands.name: developer-tools
commands.title: Developer Tools
commands.description: Connection, routing, cache, usage, and sync diagnostics for the Noesis ritual surfaces

commands.name: menubar
commands.title: Pulse & Remedy
commands.description: Current NadaBrahman remedy with source pulse inputs and quick ritual actions
